text:
Priya (CSM): Heads up — Sunrise (acct: MER-221) renewal in 14 days. Need confirmation on payment method + signer. Current PO expired, procurement asking for updated invoice. @Gabe can you confirm procurement contact and preferred payment path?

Gabe (AE): On it. I pinged their procurement team earlier today (procurement@sunrise.com), waiting a reply. Primary signer last term was Dana (CTO).

Tess (Finance): We need updated billing entity + tax ID before we issue the invoice. Do they want Sunrise US or Sunrise EU on the bill?

Priya (CSM): They verbally said US in the renewal call but procurement cc'd EU finance. @Marco any compliance/tax risk if we invoice the US entity but payment originates from EU?

Marco (Legal): If payment originates from EU entity and they're the paying party, VAT rules may apply. Ask them for VAT ID. Also if they want to shorten the term we need an amendment.

Priya (CSM): Customer is asking to shorten 12 → 9 months and prorate. Proposed numbers: 9-month term, prorated base = $90,000, Premium SLA add-on = $7,500.

Olga (Onboarding Eng): Migration to Dedicated finishes 2025-05-28 on our side — recommend term start 2025-06-01. I can move onboarding tasks if signing slips but need >= 10 business days notice. Also security team still needs the data-extract agreement signed by them.

Docusign-bot: docusign-bot: New envelope created by Gabe — envelope id xyz123. Status: waiting for recipient assignment.

Gabe (AE): Added Dana as signer but procurement prefers wire (not CC). @Tess can Finance accept wire and still do an eSign flow?

Tess (Finance): Yes, we accept wire. We need remittance instructions on the invoice and the beneficiary account details. finance@redwood.com will be the contact.

Priya (CSM): Copy of proposed invoice below (please review):
```
Invoice: Sunrise (MER-221)
Billing entity: Sunrise US LLC (TBD – need EIN or Sunrise EU if they request)
Term: 2025-06-01 — 2026-02-28 (9 months)
Lines:
 - Redwood Dedicated (annualized SKU) x1 — prorated charge $90,000
 - Premium SLA add-on x1 — $7,500
 - One-time onboarding credit (applied) — -$5,000
Subtotal: $92,500
Tax/VAT: TBD (need VAT ID if EU billed)
Payment terms: Net 30. Wire preferred. Remittance: (to be inserted by Finance)
Notes: Amendment required for shortened term + signature via DocuSign.
```

Marco (Legal): Add clause: "Payment by wire requires prior beneficiary-account confirmation via bank letter or secure portal to mitigate fraud risk." Also include the standard SOW amendment paragraph referencing the 9-month prorate. Approved otherwise.

Priya (CSM): Agreed. Timeline proposal: final invoice sent 2025-05-02, signature by 2025-05-09 so onboarding can start 2025-06-01. If procurement delays, we offer a 2-week access grace to prevent churn.

Gabe (AE): :thumbsup: I'll chase procurement today and update the DocuSign envelope to require a bank details field and a VAT ID input if needed. I'll also request a confirmation of paying entity.

Olga (Onboarding Eng): If signed by 2025-05-09 we can keep 2025-06-01 start. If signature slips past 2025-05-15 we may need to push start by ~2 weeks (resource sloting).

Docusign-bot: docusign-bot: Envelope xyz123 updated — recipient Dana@example.com added, status waiting for Dana to sign.

Gabe (AE): Dana replied: "Wire ok, will route to finance and sign once we get the remittance instructions." Says wire typically clears in 2–3 business days.

Tess (Finance): Once wire is sent please email payment receipt to finance@redwood.com. We'll issue the tax invoice PDF and mark order as active on receipt.

Priya (CSM): Marco — can you confirm final clause language so I can trigger Tess to finalize invoice?

Marco (Legal): Confirmed. Use: "Payment by wire requires prior beneficiary-account confirmation via bank letter or secure portal; Redwood reserves the right to withhold provisioning until confirmation."

Priya (CSM): Thanks — I'll update invoice and send to Gabe for envelope. Final checklist: 1) Confirm paying entity + VAT ID; 2) Insert remittance details; 3) Update DocuSign envelope; 4) Send invoice 2025-05-02; 5) Target sign by 2025-05-09.

Gabe (AE): I'll chase procurement contact now and loop in Dana.

Olga (Onboarding Eng): Noted. I'll hold the 6/1 slot pending signature.

Priya (CSM): If any blocker, flag here and escalate to me. I'll also prepare a short customer-facing note offering the 2-week access grace if legal/payment holds.

docusign-bot: docusign-bot: Envelope xyz123 status changed — awaiting signature (Dana).

Gabe (AE): Update — procurement confirmed paying entity: Sunrise US LLC, EIN 12-3456789. They requested invoice PDF + wire instructions before they approve.

Tess (Finance): I'll draft invoice with bank details and attach remittance note. Sending to Priya for final review before issuing.

Priya (CSM): Perfect — please send here when ready. Thanks team!
